name: Sunrise Mobility Flow
goal: Mobilise joints and wake up the posterior chain
description: A gentle full-body sequence for early risers who feel stiff after sleep. It opens the hips, spine and shoulders before the day begins.

name: Metabolic Morning Burn
goal: Elevate heart rate early to drive all-day calorie burn
description: A fast circuits session for people who train better before breakfast. It stacks jumping drills with squat and core work for a full metabolic stimulus.

name: Lower Body Foundation
goal: Build base strength through the quads, glutes and calves
description: A first month strength plan for newcomers to training. Every set focuses on clean technique before fatigue sets in.

name: Steady State Cardio Base
goal: Improve aerobic base with low-skill continuous movement
description: An approachable cardio session for anyone returning to exercise after a break. The pace stays conversational while the legs keep moving.

name: Core Foundation Circuit
goal: Learn to brace the trunk before adding load or speed
description: A short introduction to core training for beginners who want a flatter, firmer midsection without crunch-heavy volume.

name: Push Strength Ladder
goal: Progress from standard push-ups toward harder pressing variations
description: A pushing session for trainees who already manage sets of standard push-ups. The ladder of angles keeps the chest, shoulders and triceps working hard.

name: Tabata Ignition
goal: Maximise conditioning with short, near-maximal work intervals
description: A demanding interval session for experienced athletes who can hold form under fatigue. Expect heavy breathing from the second block onward.

name: Desk Reset Mobility
goal: Undo the effects of prolonged sitting in twelve minutes
description: A lunchtime routine for office workers with tight hips and a stiff upper back. Everything can be done beside a desk in ordinary clothes.

name: Posterior Chain Primer
goal: Wake up the glutes, hamstrings and spinal erectors
description: A corrective strength session for people whose glutes switch off from sitting all day. It restores the hinge pattern and back endurance.

name: Lateral Quickness Cardio
goal: Develop side-to-side agility while holding an elevated heart rate
description: A multi-directional cardio session for field-sport players and anyone bored of straight-line training. Lateral bounds and crawls build usable athleticism.

name: Oblique Focus Flow
goal: Carve rotational strength through the waist and lateral trunk
description: A rotation-heavy core plan for intermediate trainees who have mastered the basic plank. It targets the obliques from several angles.

name: Single-Leg Strength Block
goal: Fix left-to-right strength gaps with unilateral leg work
description: A balanced lower-body session built around split stances and deep squat patterns. It suits lifters chasing symmetrical, injury-resistant legs.

name: Full Body Fat Blaster
goal: Burn fat by training every major muscle group in one session
description: A complete workout for busy people who only have time to train three times a week. Each block hits a different region while the heart rate stays high.

name: Hip and Hamstring Mobility
goal: Open tight hips and lengthen the hamstrings for deeper squatting
description: A focused mobility block for lifters whose squat depth stalls because of tight hips. It pairs dynamic holds with active stretching.

name: Upper Body Push Circuit
goal: Push pressing volume to build chest, shoulder and tricep endurance
description: A high-volume upper-body session for advanced trainees with no equipment. The six blocks demand real pacing discipline to finish.

name: Sprint Interval Cardio
goal: Raise top-end conditioning through repeated sprint efforts
description: A running-based interval workout done entirely on the spot. It suits conditioned athletes preparing for stop-start sports.

name: Morning Wake-Up Stretch
goal: Loosen the whole body within twelve quiet minutes
description: A soft flow to run before coffee for anyone who wakes up tight. It moves the spine through every direction in a short, calming sequence.

name: Glute and Hamstring Builder
goal: Grow stronger hips and hamstrings with high-rep loading
description: A posterior-chain session for lifters chasing stronger hips without a barbell. Volume and tempo do the work instead of external load.

name: HIIT Total Torcher
goal: Drive maximum calorie burn in half an hour of hard work
description: An unforgiving circuit for experienced trainees who want a serious sweat. Six blocks combine explosive jumps with a long core finisher.

name: Beginner Core Stability
goal: Develop anti-movement control before attempting dynamic abs work
description: A gentle core session that teaches the trunk to stay still while the limbs move. It is safe for beginners and kind to the lower back.

name: Total Body Strength Reset
goal: Rebuild training habits with simple, effective full-body lifts
description: A returning-to-training session built on five familiar movements. It restores strength quickly without overwhelming recovery.

name: Calorie Crush Circuits
goal: Chain short bursts together to keep calorie expenditure high
description: A circuit-style session that never lets the heart rate drop for long. Ideal for intermediate trainees chasing fat loss four days a week.

name: Ropeless Jump Rope Cardio
goal: Simulate skipping mechanics to build calf endurance and timing
description: A low-skill cardio session that mimics jump rope footwork without needing a rope or much space. Great for small rooms and shared flats.

name: Core Sculpt Express
goal: Strengthen the abdominals and back in a fifteen-minute block
description: A fast core routine that fits into any lunch break. It balances flexion, rotation and extension so no part of the trunk is neglected.

name: Hip Mobility Deep Dive
goal: Gain usable hip range for deeper, more comfortable squatting
description: A dedicated hip session for runners and lifters who feel blocked at the bottom of a squat. It alternates active strength with long holds.

name: Advanced Push Progression
goal: Approach one-arm push-up strength through relentless volume
description: A serious pressing workout for advanced bodyweight athletes. Twenty-six hard sets separate those who finish from those who do not.

name: Express HIIT 12
goal: Fit a genuine conditioning session into twelve minutes
description: A bite-size interval workout for people who claim they have no time. Five short blocks raise the heart rate without any complicated choreography.

name: Endurance Cardio Ladder
goal: Extend work capacity with progressively longer cardio blocks
description: A long-form conditioning session that raises the ceiling on sustained effort. Rep counts climb through the first four blocks before a mobility cool-down.

name: Deep Core Burn
goal: Attack the lower abdominals with long-lever loading
description: A lower-ab focused session for intermediate trainees who want visible definition and real trunk control. Pace matters more than speed here.

name: Full Body Express
goal: Train the whole body once in twenty efficient minutes
description: A compact full-body option for beginners with busy schedules. It covers push, hinge, squat and core without a single complicated movement.

name: Yoga-Inspired Wind Down
goal: Settle the nervous system and lengthen tight muscles before bed
description: An evening flow for anyone who struggles to switch off after work. Slow holds and longer breathing calm the body for better sleep.

name: Metabolic Strength Circuits
goal: Pair heavy strength blocks with metabolic fillers for dual benefit
description: A hybrid session that lifts and conditions at once, saving time without sacrificing results. It works well for four-day intermediate splits.

name: Lunge and Squat Lab
goal: Push leg strength and depth through varied squat patterns
description: A lower-body session that rotates four squat variations to keep the stimulus fresh. Advanced trainees should slow every descent for full control.

name: Ladder Sprint Cardio
goal: Hold high intensity across five escalating cardio rounds
description: A hard conditioning ladder for athletes who need game-ready fitness. Each round adds reps while rest stays short.

name: Midline Strength Core
goal: Build a trunk that resists extension, rotation and flexion under fatigue
description: A high-volume core session that pairs dynamic abs work with long isometric holds. It is designed for advanced trainees chasing a rock-solid midline.

name: Deep Stretch Reset
goal: Restore range after heavy training weeks with long static holds
description: A recovery-session for advanced athletes whose volume has tightened them up. Long holds and slow breathing undo accumulated tension.

name: Power and Plyo Full Body
goal: Express force quickly through the entire body
description: A power-biased session combining explosive jumps with strict strength work. It suits athletes who need speed as much as endurance.

name: Living Room Sweat
goal: Get a real sweat in a small space with simple jumps
description: A beginner-friendly circuit that stays within a yoga mat of floor space. Four blocks, no equipment and no impact on the neighbours.

name: Everyday Cardio Base
goal: Keep a healthy heart with low-skill, moderate-intensity movement
description: A straightforward cardio option for people building the habit of daily movement. Nothing technical, just consistent work at a steady pace.

name: Equipment-Free Full Body Base
goal: Cover every movement pattern with nothing but body weight
description: A complete first-month plan that trains squat, push, hinge and brace in one session. Ideal for home users starting from zero.

name: Double-Tabata Cardio Blast
goal: Repeat two tabata waves to extend time at peak intensity
description: Two back-to-back waves of short, sharp intervals for intermediate trainers. The second wave is where the conditioning really improves.

name: Functional Strength Flow
goal: Build strength that transfers to lifting, carrying and sport
description: A flow-style session where each block moves into the next with minimal setup. It trains the body as one unit rather than in isolation.

name: Run Prep Cardio
goal: Prepare the legs and lungs for a faster running session
description: A primer for runners training on days off from the road. It activates the calves and glutes while lifting the heart rate gradually.

name: Advanced Core Torque
goal: Generate and control rotation with heavy abdominal loading
description: A rotation and long-lever core workout for advanced trainees. Six demanding blocks finish with a full minute of bracing.

name: Supple Spine Mobility
goal: Restore segmented spinal movement for heavier training days
description: A spine-focused mobility routine for advanced lifters whose backs have grown stiff from hinge volume. It moves each region without forcing range.

name: Sprint Tabata Machine
goal: Hold sprint-quality output through repeated hard intervals
description: Five blocks of near-maximal work with disciplined rest. It is built for advanced trainees chasing a serious conditioning edge.

name: Bodyweight Beast Circuit
goal: Accumulate serious total-body volume without a single weight
description: A long, grinding circuit for advanced trainees who travel or have no gym access. Six blocks cover every major pattern at high volume.

name: Floor Core Endurance
goal: Hold tension for longer to build a fatigue-resistant midline
description: A floor-only routine that extends plank time while keeping the abs under constant load. It fits neatly at the end of any session.

name: Joint Care Mobility
goal: Keep shoulders, spine and hips moving well under training load
description: A joint-focused routine for people training hard most days of the week. It maintains the ranges that heavy pressing and hinging tend to steal.

name: Weekend Grind Full Body
goal: Bank maximum weekly volume in one long session
description: The longest session in the library, built for advanced trainees who train fewer days per week. It delivers a week's worth of stimulus in forty-five minutes.

name: Iron Interval HIIT
goal: Blend strength and conditioning into a single hard session
description: A strength-flavoured interval workout that keeps rep counts high while rest stays short. It is a favourite for fat-loss phases.

name: Weekend Warrior Circuit
goal: Reward a hard training week with a complete full-body test
description: A Saturday-style circuit mixing squat, press, lateral and core work across six blocks. It rewards fitness built over months of consistent training.
